source: G. P. Sutton and O. Biblarz, Rocket Propulsion Elements, 9th ed., Wiley, 2017, Table 5-5, p. 180
use: External comparison only. Not a RocketForge oracle and not runtime data. Only the quantities compared below are transcribed; specific gravity and volume mixture ratio are omitted.

conditions.chemistry: adiabatic combustion, isentropic expansion of ideal gases; Isp given as shifting and/or frozen
conditions.mixture_ratio: by mass; 'approximate maximum values of Is'

bands.rationale: Classification threshold, not a fitted tolerance. The source states no reactant temperatures, predates the shipped thermo.lib, prints 3-4 significant figures and calls its mixture ratios approximate. A cell inside the band is 'agrees within source-condition uncertainty'; every cell outside it is listed under 'anomalies' with a classification the tests check.

anomalies.evidence: The same row's c*, molar mass and frozen Isp agree within 1.1 %, which a 300 K chamber-temperature error would not allow.

anomalies.classification: source column placement (shifting and frozen swapped)
anomalies.evidence: 'Shifting 334' at 1.83 is the frozen value at 1.83, and 'frozen 365' at 2.30 the shifting value at 2.30; a frozen Isp above the shifting one is not physical here.
3258 K matches O/F 1.34 and 3152 K matches O/F 1.08; the rows' c*, molar mass and Isp agree as printed.
c* is 5 to 10 % below the computed value on either basis, and below the ideal c* of the row's own printed T, M and k, while the same row's Isp agrees within 1 %; c* and Isp cannot both hold.

anomalies.classification: source basis (frozen-throat c*), not an error
anomalies.evidence: 2128 m/s is the ideal c* of the row's own printed T, M and k (2127) and agrees with CEA's frozen-throat c*; it is outside the band only against the equilibrium c* compared here. The row's Isp, 334 s, is likewise its frozen value.

The same rows' chamber temperature, molar mass and k agree within 1.5 %; 297 s is not reachable at that temperature and molar mass (ideal frozen Isp from the rows' own T, M and k is 262 and 260 s), and the same 297 is printed for both rows.
